## Work package / scope
- Planned ID: JFA-__ (or explain why this is an unplanned maintenance change)
- Links to relevant plan section, ADRs, dependencies:

## Change and public/private boundaries
- Summary and user impact:
- Public/private data processed:
- Source of truth and any downstream service contracts:

## Checks and evidence
- [ ] Clean install, typecheck, tests, build
- [ ] Security checks and negative-path authorization tests, when applicable
- [ ] Accessibility checks for UI changes
- [ ] Migrations and rollback plan, when applicable
- [ ] Documentation and acceptance evidence updated
- [ ] No secrets, PII, credential URLs, or fabricated production status

## Live deployment status
- [ ] Verified with link/evidence
- [ ] Not yet deployed / explicitly unverified

**Roadmap accounting:** map a work package to its real merged PR only after checking acceptance evidence. A PR number is not a work-package number.
